C-FIX-010-COMMAND-PALETTE-SHORTCUT.Name: Restore the macOS Command Palette shortcut
C-FIX-010-COMMAND-PALETTE-SHORTCUT.Summary: Restore UC-025 on macOS: Shift+Command+P opens the existing root Command Palette from editor and welcome surfaces, Escape closes it, and the chord never duplicates a paragraph. Keep the renderer registry, app-level route and native View menu accelerator aligned.
C-FIX-010-COMMAND-PALETTE-SHORTCUT.Problem: FIX-010 records that Shift+Command+P has no dispatch route even though the palette component, localized description and UC-025 contract already exist.
C-FIX-010-COMMAND-PALETTE-SHORTCUT.ApprovalBasis: The owner instructed the standard GRACE plan, verification and two-clean-review workflow for the agreed post-2.6 stabilization boundary on 2026-10-20. The immediately preceding instruction excludes Windows and Linux until separate authorization, so this change is macOS-only.

Goals.Goal: Give the existing root palette one authoritative macOS command id and accelerator.
Open it from both document and welcome surfaces without colliding with paragraph duplication or IME input.

Constraints.Constraint: Do not change Windows or Linux behavior, add a second palette implementation, or broaden the active release train.

Keep native-menu dispatch and the browser-test fallback idempotent: the operating system owns the native accelerator in packaged builds; app keydown supplies the browser harness and non-native surface.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No palette redesign, fuzzy-search change, keybinding customization, release version, tag or publication.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: On macOS Shift+Command+P opens the populated root Command Palette from an editor or welcome screen, and Escape closes it.
The command registry advertises view.command-palette; the macOS View menu dispatches the same id; shortcut audits find one owner and no collision with edit.duplicate.
Windows and Linux receive no new accelerator or app-level key route.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Real-key Shift+Meta+P opens the populated palette, Escape closes it, duplicate remains on Shift+Meta+D, and static menu/registry/routes agree.

Assumptions.Assumption: The owner's request to start the already-proposed pack is approval of this narrowly recorded FIX-010 behavior; execution is sequential because the four bundles share routed runtime projections.
